name: print-social-neon-dark-social-media-grid-kit
title: Neon-on-black social media grid template kit
whatItIs: A 3x4 grid of dark social post templates featuring neon pink/purple/orange gradients, glowing line icons, and a bold neon-outlined 'SOCIAL MEDIA' centerpiece card.
whatItMeans: A unifying near-black background lets varied neon gradient accents each pop individually while the grid as a whole still reads as one coherent brand kit.
techniques: keep every card on near-black so neon gradient accents read as glowing
use one card as an oversized 'title' anchor within the grid to break rhythm
apply consistent glow/blur effects to icons and text for a unified light-emitting feel

vocabulary.definition: a soft blurred light halo applied around an element to simulate luminance
